purpose: Cute instrument portraits for the fixed Atelier instrument gallery.

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production instrument-selection sprite atlas for a music-learning app. Create an extremely charming, beautifully designed cohesive collection of cute musical-instrument characters. Square 2048x2048 canvas divided invisibly into EXACTLY four equal columns and four equal rows, 16 equal square cells. One complete musical instrument per cell, precisely centered at each cell center. Leave 13% empty margin inside each cell on every side; nothing crosses into adjacent cells. No grid lines. Flat uniform warm ivory background #fffdf8. Each instrument has an adorable tiny gentle face, two small dark eyes with a highlight, tiny smile and blush cheeks, integrated subtly into its body, no human limbs. Round soft silhouettes with real recognizable instrument construction. Refined hand-painted gouache children's-book artwork, delicate cocoa-brown outline, soft honey wood, dusty apricot, ivory, sage and muted golden brass. Charming and beautifully composed, soft small shadows. A finished premium music stationery illustration, not rough primitive line art or photorealism. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, decorations, borders or captions anywhere. Order matters strictly:
ROW 1 LEFT TO RIGHT: (1) a honey-brown upright piano with complete keyboard and cute face above keys; (2) violin with bow and warm carved figure-eight body; (3) cello with bow and short endpin; (4) classical acoustic guitar with circular sound hole.
ROW 2 LEFT TO RIGHT: (5) Chinese pipa, plump pear-shaped wooden lute with short bent headstock four pegs and four strings; (6) Chinese erhu, slender neck and small hexagonal wooden resonator near bottom with bow; (7) Chinese ruan lute with clearly circular flat wooden soundbox and long fretted neck; (8) Chinese guzheng, long horizontal wooden zither on low stand with many strings and bridges, front three-quarter view.
ROW 3 LEFT TO RIGHT: (9) silver western transverse flute arranged diagonally with round keys; (10) black clarinet with silver keywork and flared bell; (11) golden alto saxophone; (12) golden trumpet.
ROW 4 LEFT TO RIGHT: (13) warm brass French horn with circular tubing and wide bell; (14) Chinese sheng, upright mouth organ with an arrangement of many vertical bamboo and metal pipes at different heights rising from compact windchest; (15) Chinese yangqin, horizontal trapezoidal hammered dulcimer with visible strings and two slender beaters; (16) vintage cream and sage microphone on small stand for the voice instrument.
Every full instrument visible with ample padding, consistent cute expression, only one character in each exact cell.
